errors.badUrl: The feed address must start with http:// or https://. Fix the address in the settings.
errors.timeout: The feed did not respond within 20 seconds. Check the address and your connection.
errors.network: Could not reach the feed. Check your internet connection and the address.
errors.notFound: Feed not found ({status}). Check the address.
errors.http: The feed server returned an unexpected response ({status}). It will be retried on the next check.
errors.notFeed: This address is not an RSS or Atom feed.
errors.xmlInvalid: Could not read the feed: malformed XML (line {line}).

manifest.description: Notifies you about new entries in RSS and Atom feeds.

setup.title: No feeds added yet
setup.body: Add the RSS or Atom address of the blogs, news sites or projects you want to follow. New posts show up here as notifications; when you add a feed only its latest 5 entries arrive.

feeds.label: Feeds
feeds.help: Each row is a separate feed. If the display name is empty, the feed's own title is used. Only the latest 5 entries of a newly added feed are notified.
